_: RT2 (2026-10-02) - THE RUNTIME DOCUMENT'S REPAINT CLASS, ONE TABLE FOR BOTH LANGUAGES. The per-bar runtime lane runs a member's Pine bar by bar over CLOSED-OR-FORMING bars it is handed, so a value it writes at bar i depends on bars after i only through what the run is HANDED about those bars: a clock leaf computed from the fetch's right edge, the wall clock, another symbol's or timeframe's bars, per-tick state, or the viewer. This table names those reads; every other read is the run's own per-bar computation and reaches no bar after its own. Read by `runtimeRepaint.js` (the member door) and `api/services/runtime_repaint.py` (the store's save door); a corpus parity rail holds the two to one answer per script. The vocabulary and the reach -> class step are the HOST linter's (`ast/lint.js::modeFromReach`, `ast_lint.mode_from_reach`); nothing here names a class.
_reach: A reach is how many bars AFTER its own a value at bar i depends on: a whole number >= 0, or "unbounded" (no bar after which the value is final). `ast/closedTable.json` declares the same thing per function and per clock leaf; this file never restates one of those declarations.

clockReads._: Pine spellings that reach a clock leaf of `closedTable.json::clock`, and the leaf. The reach of each is the HOST LINTER's answer for that leaf (`astReach({type:'series', name: <leaf>})`) over the shared manifest, and nothing else: since RT4 the nine leaves that read the fetch's right edge declare their `forward` THERE (`closedTable.json::_clock_right_edge`), so this file carries no clock reach of its own. Bound to `pine.js` (`BUILTIN_BARSTATE_SERIES`, `pineClockKeyOf`) by `runtimeRepaint.test.js`, so a spelling the host lane resolves differently is red.

reads._: Reads the host linter does not classify (it refuses them or has no node for them), each with its reach and the reason. Conservative: a read whose dependence on later bars cannot be bounded is "unbounded".
varip: `varip` keeps state across the ticks of a forming bar, so a bar's value depends on how many times it was run
barstate.isnew: `barstate.isnew` is a fact about how many times the script ran on a bar, not about the bar
chart.left_visible_bar_time: the chart's visible range is the viewer's, and moves with every scroll
chart.right_visible_bar_time: the chart's visible range is the viewer's, and moves with every scroll
barmerge.lookahead_on: a request with look-ahead on reads the period a bar sits inside, which has not finished when the bar is drawn
lookahead_on: a request with look-ahead on reads the period a bar sits inside, which has not finished when the bar is drawn

namedFlags._: A named argument whose value decides whether a script reads ahead or per tick. Any value other than the listed safe one is "unbounded".

requests._: A data request. The request of THIS chart at THIS chart's period is the expression itself (`pineRuntimeFrontend.js` folds it; `pine.js::Resolver.requestTargetOf` decides it) and reads no other bars; its canonical spelling is matched here. Every other request reads bars this pane does not hold and whose alignment on a forming period is not measured, so it is "unbounded" - and the member door also declines it by name (`runtime:request`, from the lowered program).
